title: Open New Lines (o, O)
instruction_text:
Create new lines efficiently!

'o' = open a new line below and enter insert mode
'O' = open a new line above and enter insert mode

Your task: Insert 'Second line' between the other lines.

Steps:
1. Position cursor on 'First line'
2. Press 'o' (opens line below)
3. Type 'Second line'
4. Press ESC
5. Save and quit with :wq
target_content:
First line
Second line
Third line
